programme.desc: A mother's dream of riding a scooter is not as easy as it seems.

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: One Faith
programme.desc: Sometimes, all it takes for a melting pot to turn into a blazing furnace is a mere spark. Especially in a country like ours, where multiple faiths co-exist and cross paths every day. This is the day in the life of India, where two dominant forces face-off in a battle of who-blinks-first. And only one faith will triumph.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Aamad
programme.desc: "Aamad" in essence is the story of a father and son and their shared inheritance of loss. An inheritance that tears them apart and yet binds them together. Abhay returns home to find his father on his deathbed. Old painful memories resurface. Will he be able to make amends for the faults of his past? As his father passes on, will this be Abhay’s rites of passage? Will Abhay heed the call of the bloodline, despite the tinkering strains of the past?

programme.title: Kaande Pohe
programme.desc: Kaande Pohe - A Maharashtrian snack traditionally served when a boy visits a girls' family for the first time in an arranged marriage set up. The day is called 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'. There is no data on this strategy's success rate. Meet Sanjay and Manisha who are on their 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Jai Mata Di
programme.desc: Mumbai is a funny city. Call it a melting pot, the glamour capital, or simply the most open and safe place to be around. But when it comes to two people living under the same roof without a marriage certificate, it’s not religion, caste, or even the parents that’s the biggest hurdle. It’s a species that dictates the law of the land without really owning it. The Society Secretary. But as they say, there’s nothing mom can’t solve. With that belief on the one hand, and a funny bone in the other, we say Jai Mata Di!

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Long Drive
programme.desc: Vikram, Zain and Aman are on a long drive together. But when Vikram takes an unexpected turn, his friends aren’t sure what to expect. Will they make it back in time? And does Vikram have something on his mind? Watch Long Drive to find out.

programme.title: L

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: One Faith
programme.desc: Sometimes, all it takes for a melting pot to turn into a blazing furnace is a mere spark. Especially in a country like ours, where multiple faiths co-exist and cross paths every day. This is the day in the life of India, where two dominant forces face-off in a battle of who-blinks-first. And only one faith will triumph.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Aamad
programme.desc: "Aamad" in essence is the story of a father and son and their shared inheritance of loss. An inheritance that tears them apart and yet binds them together. Abhay returns home to find his father on his deathbed. Old painful memories resurface. Will he be able to make amends for the faults of his past? As his father passes on, will this be Abhay’s rites of passage? Will Abhay heed the call of the bloodline, despite the tinkering strains of the past?

programme.title: Kaande Pohe
programme.desc: Kaande Pohe - A Maharashtrian snack traditionally served when a boy visits a girls' family for the first time in an arranged marriage set up. The day is called 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'. There is no data on this strategy's success rate. Meet Sanjay and Manisha who are on their 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Jai Mata Di
programme.desc: Mumbai is a funny city. Call it a melting pot, the glamour capital, or simply the most open and safe place to be around. But when it comes to two people living under the same roof without a marriage certificate, it’s not religion, caste, or even the parents that’s the biggest hurdle. It’s a species that dictates the law of the land without really owning it. The Society Secretary. But as they say, there’s nothing mom can’t solve. With that belief on the one hand, and a funny bone in the other, we say Jai Mata Di!

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Rear View
programme.desc: Between 'Start Trip' and 'End Trip' there’s a journey that can potentially change lives, if only we open up and not let technology come in the way of human connection.

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Khujli
programme.desc: What happens when Girdharilal and Roopmati decide to scratch a 25-year-old itch? Secret desires come out, hidden fantasies are revealed, long-lost fire is rekindled, and things can’t help but get a little…kinky.

programme.title: Cuddly
programme.desc: Necessity is the mother of invention. But can it replace mother's love?

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Ved And Arya
programme.desc: Arya turns up unannounced at Ved’s home on a Friday night. Ved knows it's not just a regular surprise and that Arya has something else on her mind. Will all go down exactly as planned?

programme.title: Jai Mata Di
programme.desc: Mumbai is a funny city. Call it a melting pot, the glamour capital, or simply the most open and safe place to be around. But when it comes to two people living under the same roof without a marriage certificate, it’s not religion, caste, or even the parents that’s the biggest hurdle. It’s a species that dictates the law of the land without really owning it. The Society Secretary. But as they say, there’s nothing mom can’t solve. With that belief on the one hand, and a funny bone in the other, we say Jai Mata Di!

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: Dum Dum Deega Deega
programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.title: Naamkaran
programme.desc: When it comes to new beginnings, families have a way of always being there. Sometimes it's as simple as a good- morning forward. But for Jay, it's something slightly more dramatic. Watch Naamkaran, as Jay and his (uninvited) family take on a new challenge.

programme.title: One Faith
programme.desc: Sometimes, all it takes for a melting pot to turn into a blazing furnace is a mere spark. Especially in a country like ours, where multiple faiths co-exist and cross paths every day. This is the day in the life of India, where two dominant forces face-off in a battle of who-blinks-first. And only one faith will triumph.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: Laugh

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: 10 years ago, a boy abandoned his alcoholic mother. Now a man, he returns to meet her.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Suno

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: Anvith's friend Karthik is leaving school and moving to another city as his parents are getting divorced. This news makes Anvith very sad. The reason for their divorce which Karthik reveals to Anvith is a regular heated argument between Karthik's parents. Then Anvith also starts noticing the same argument between his parents. So, Anvith decides to do everything right so that their parents don't fight, but end up ruining everything which leads to a more heated argument.

programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Harmless
programme.desc: A boy down on his luck. A girl looking for thrills. A plot is hatched. A kidnapping is staged. As far as crimes go, this one seems harmless. But, as with all things, there is a price to pay. A hefty price. Harmless begins as a crime-thriller and develops into a dramatic adventure with a little bit of romance thrown in.

programme.title: Laugh
programme.desc: A film about who we were and who we've become , how socialising was and where its reached ,how something as simple as laughing has taken a complicated turn

programme.title: L
programme.desc: A mother's dream of riding a scooter is not as easy as it seems.

programme.title: Love, Bites
programme.desc: Love, bites is a romantic drama where the story revolves around the lives of Karthik, an artist, and Meghna, scientist. Their sexual chemistry is obvious to everyone. Even to those who haven’t seen them together, since they like to flaunt the hickeys on their body. But something changes in their equation when the hickey becomes a bridge of memory that leads to an old sexual encounter Meghna had which Karthik finds out about. Will Meghna be able to help Karthik erase the marks of her past? Or will Karthik just to have to wake up to a realization that the past, even though it haunts, might not be real.

programme.title: One Faith
programme.desc: Sometimes, all it takes for a melting pot to turn into a blazing furnace is a mere spark. Especially in a country like ours, where multiple faiths co-exist and cross paths every day. This is the day in the life of India, where two dominant forces face-off in a battle of who-blinks-first. And only one faith will triumph.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Aamad
programme.desc: "Aamad" in essence is the story of a father and son and their shared inheritance of loss. An inheritance that tears them apart and yet binds them together. Abhay returns home to find his father on his deathbed. Old painful memories resurface. Will he be able to make amends for the faults of his past? As his father passes on, will this be Abhay’s rites of passage? Will Abhay heed the call of the bloodline, despite the tinkering strains of the past?

programme.title: Kaande Pohe
programme.desc: Kaande Pohe - A Maharashtrian snack traditionally served when a boy visits a girls' family for the first time in an arranged marriage set up. The day is called 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'. There is no data on this strategy's success rate. Meet Sanjay and Manisha who are on their 'Kaande Pohe Cha Kaaryakaram'.

programme.title: Rebel
programme.desc: A young man leaves Belgium to help war victims in Syria, but is forced to join an armed group and is left stranded in AL Raqqa. While at home his little brother becomes easy prey for jihadi recruiters. The only thing their mother has left with is to protect: her Son.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Agli Baar

programme.title: Bhaiyya Morey
programme.desc: "His name is Sasha. Lost and found in this tamasha." On a long, dark night - a young rapper, Sasha is on his way to Goa when all of a sudden, his car breaks down. An old woman finds him stranded in the middle of nowhere and reluctantly agrees to help.

programme.title: Half Of My Heart
programme.desc: Tasha and Raghav have broken up. Again. If you've been in love, you know sometimes, it takes nothing to have the biggest fight. Half her things are there with him, and half of his - misplaced. And all of this in the middle of a national lockdown.

programme.title: Bapu

programme.title: Aamad

programme.title: Ved And Arya

programme.title: R.i.p
programme.desc: Two old men wake up to the same matrimonial ad in the morning paper. What follows is something totally unexpected. After all, it's never too late to find love!

programme.title: Mamta Tonic
programme.desc: A travelling saleswoman. 3 potential customers. She weighs the pros of her homemade tonic against the cons of making tough choices in life.

programme.title: Deuce
programme.desc: A mother and a son argue about love, insecurities and acceptance around an intense match of table tennis. Who wins? Who loses? Watch Deuce.

programme.title: The Last Day
programme.desc: Two roommates, on the night one of them is moving out after 8 years of staying together. What do they really want to say to each other in the final few minutes? Can they say it all?

programme.title: Life After
programme.desc: Before we draw the curtain on Breast Cancer Awareness Month, let's shed some light on those who battle it with every little that makes life worth loving, and living. We salute the undying courage in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Khujli
programme.desc: What happens when Girdharilal and Roopmati decide to scratch a 25-year-old itch? Secret desires come out, hidden fantasies are revealed, long-lost fire is rekindled, and things can’t help but get a little…kinky.

programme.title: Weekends
programme.desc: Tara may have a problem leaving her comfort zone but not all things have to have practical solutions right like Raghav thinks, right? Maybe some things are just meant to be felt…unless there’s an eviction notice over your head!

programme.title: Upgrade
programme.desc: What happens when Safa a successful, well-to-do, married woman is tempted to open a window to her past and meet her ex-boyfriend Maaz on Valentine’s Day?

programme.title: The Last Clue
programme.desc: It’s Zoey’s 16th birthday, and Samar seems to have forgotten. How can he, after all this time?! Growing up in the same housing complex, going to each other’s birthday parties as a kid? It’s a little different this time. They’re staying home, and they haven’t met in a while. And there may be newly blossoming feelings involved on either side... Did Samar forget, or is this birthday going to be the most memorable one?

programme.title: The Last Bencher
programme.desc: Vishal and Niki have always been project partners since the first year of college. He is the topper and she, the last bencher. Their last project before their virtual graduation is due. Can a topper and last bencher be nothing more than just project partners?

programme.title: The Last Surprise
programme.desc: Yash and Tara are meeting for their first date in this 'new normal.' He is cautious, she is just happy to be free and out in the open again. But she doesn't quite know what he has in store for her. Can dating in this new world feel like the old times? Will she feel the butterflies again after this long?

programme.title: Silence Please
programme.desc: Kartik and Radhika are college best friends. They’re close, share everything, and go to each other for both approvals and advice. But Kartik just found out some very upsetting news that Radhika hid from him. Will their friendship make it through?

programme.title: Second First Date
programme.desc: Ishaan and Fiza's story began over a phone screen. After 4 months, Fiza has finally 'dared' to surprise Ishaan, and they had their first, no wait…second…umm actually, they had a second first date! Would it be awkward or unforgettable?

programme.title: Half Half
programme.desc: From tiffins to secrets — Mansi and Sharan used to share everything as kids. They were those friends who were teased as “girlfriend-boyfriend”, even before they knew what love is. Now, 6 years later, Sharan is on his way to become “famous-shamous”. And Mansi? Well, she just hopes that some things haven’t changed.

programme.title: Jinx
programme.desc: Jenny has paid a surprise visit to Mira’s house to help her through a difficult breakup. But Mira is not happy with this intrusion. Will Jenny find a way to comfort her best friend?

programme.title: The Big Break
programme.desc: At 60, Mr. Mehta is about to give his life’s biggest interview. But his interviewer Malvika isn’t too happy with his answers. Everything depends on this. Will Mr. Mehta make it through?

programme.title: Baby Shower
programme.desc: Why did Cathy run away from her own baby shower? Her husband Tejas tries to figure out what’s really on her mind. Can they still celebrate their big day, their way?

programme.title: Bae
programme.desc: A thirteen year old is stuck with her masi who is single this Valentine’s Day AGAIN! How will these two get through the clichés and romance that surround them today?

programme.title: Bae
programme.desc: A thirteen year old is stuck with her masi who is single this Valentine’s Day AGAIN! How will these two get through the clichés and romance that surround them today?

programme.title: Not Out

programme.title: Third Wheel

programme.title: Kebab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: Gaurav has planned yet another perfect date for his long-time girlfriend Vaani, — at the same spot where they went on their first-ever camping trip! Two small problems though: (1) She is not here, and (2) Someone else he just can't get along with is here, instead of her. What will Gaurav do when his forever Kabab Mein Haddi is being extra clingy today?

programme.title: Suno
programme.desc: An experimental night in bed ends up with a mark for the world to see. As the world looks at the mark left in bed, the couple is forced to look inside themselves and their relationship.

programme.title: Aamad
programme.desc: "Aamad" in essence is the story of a father and son and their shared inheritance of loss. An inheritance that tears them apart and yet binds them together. Abhay returns home to find his father on his deathbed. Old painful memories resurface. Will he be able to make amends for the faults of his past? As his father passes on, will this be Abhay’s rites of passage? Will Abhay heed the call of the bloodline, despite the tinkering strains of the past?

programme.title: The Last Bencher
programme.desc: Vishal and Niki have always been project partners since the first year of college. He is the topper and she, the last bencher. Their last project before their virtual graduation is due. Can a topper and last bencher be nothing more than just project partners?

programme.title: Kheer
programme.desc: As we age, life can get lonelier and the definition of relationships, mature. Kheer is a delightful serving of love and companionship where secrets get accidentally spilt and shared.

programme.title: Jai Mata Di
programme.desc: Mumbai is a funny city. Call it a melting pot, the glamour capital, or simply the most open and safe place to be around. But when it comes to two people living under the same roof without a marriage certificate, it’s not religion, caste, or even the parents that’s the biggest hurdle. It’s a species that dictates the law of the land without really owning it. The Society Secretary. But as they say, there’s nothing mom can’t solve. With that belief on the one hand, and a funny bone in the other, we say Jai Mata Di!

programme.title: Phullu
programme.desc: Uneducated Phullu realizes women's menstrual inconveniences and raises awareness about the issue.

programme.title: The Great Gambler
programme.desc: Twins Kishan and Kanhaiya swap identities. Kanhaiya helps Kishan woo his love and eliminate rivals, but rowdy Bijli, who loves Kishan, tries to foil their plans.

programme.title: Buddha Mil Gaya
programme.desc: Two unemployed men find a missing millionaire. When his ex-associates die, the duo become prime murder suspects.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: A super-rich NRI seeks a bride in India, falls for a village girl, but she may be a pawn in a deadly conspiracy.

programme.title: Albela
programme.desc: Tourist guide Tony is smitten by Sonia, who seeks her mother's grave in Goa. Believing she's his fated princess, he tries to woo her.

programme.title: Speed
programme.desc: Asha is pregnant by one of three men she had affairs with. She moves to Mauritius to start fresh, but her past soon catches up, leading to a hilarious mess.

programme.title: Bumper Draw
programme.desc: Spanish Laura travels to India seeking missing boyfriend Robert. Her quest leads to Paharganj's shady lanes, where she learns his disappearance is linked to a murder.

programme.title: 50 Lakh
programme.desc: When NCB offers a prize for capturing crime kingpin Irfan Khan, he plans to hijack a plane to Kathmandu, recruiting four unsuspecting men to assist him.

programme.title: Saath Saath
programme.desc: Avinash, a publisher, doesn't chase riches. But his wife's pregnancy brings financial strain, drifting him from his values.

programme.title: Ghar Ek Mandir
programme.desc: Brothers Prem, Vijay, and Ravi's lives are ruined when Prem is assassinated. Vijay is blinded by love for Sapna, who is a pawn in a scheme to destroy the family.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Geeta and her father struggle to send brother Prakash abroad for education. He returns, marries a rich girl, and splits from family. They pay off the loan. Geeta falls for affluent Ranjit, whose father opposes.

programme.title: Griha Pravesh
programme.desc: Amar and Mansi's happy marriage stagnates. Trouble arises when a young woman at Amar's office develops a liking for him.

programme.title: Pathar Ke Insan
programme.desc: Gifted singer Sita & renowned dancer Lata, talented sisters, compete in their careers. Their rivalry leads to a competition with far-reaching psychological consequences.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Rati introduces college boyfriend Raj to her father, who accuses Raj's father of being a corrupt cop. Raj joins police to clear his family's name.

programme.title: Guns Of Banaras
programme.desc: Guddu's lucky bike is stolen. While searching, he gets entangled in crime, discovering his bike is used for drug transport.

programme.title: Jail Yatra
programme.desc: Raju often gets jailed for trouble with police. When he gets involved with a gangster, he's in perilous danger, but no one believes him.

programme.title: Dariya Dil
programme.desc: Hardworking farmer Amar Singh gets a government tractor. His success and refusal of bribes anger his landlord, who assassinates him. Amar Singh's son, Vikraanta, seeks revenge.

programme.title: Nishant
programme.desc: Doctor Aryan and nurse Annie care for an old man. Aryan marries his granddaughter Nikita to embezzle wealth, but she discovers their plan.

programme.title: Anita
programme.desc: An Indian father-son duo goes to London. The son, I, discovers his community is threatened by white nationalists. He decides to fight the racism.

programme.title: Dil Ka Rishta
programme.desc: Jai accidentally kills his lover's husband. When she gets amnesia, he comforts her, she falls for him. Guilt-ridden, he faces a dilemma: confess or reciprocate?

programme.title: Mera Muqaddar
programme.desc: Suraj leaves Shanti and their newborn. He marries Ruchi, who also has a son. The two boys grow up fighting, unaware they are half-brothers.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Orphaned in the jungle, Tarzan saves explorer Ruby, and they fall in love. When Ruby's troupe finds them, they capture Tarzan for a circus.

programme.title: Bhabhi
programme.desc: Himmatram disowns alcoholic son Sunderlal, leaving everything to grandniece Suman. Sunderlal tries various ways to get his name in the will. Will he succeed?

programme.title: Luck
programme.desc: Underworld kingpin Musa, a luck believer, designs deadly, high-prize adventure sports where only the exceptionally lucky survive and win.

programme.title: Rajkumar
programme.desc: Thambore & Araavali end enmity through marriage, but a fateful incident reignites rivalry. The prince's love for the princess is their only hope for peace.

programme.title: Maachis
programme.desc: Orphaned Mangla's arranged marriage to blind Anand occurs after her lover betrays her. Initially hesitant, she falls for Anand, but he drives her out upon learning of her ex.

programme.title: Jhoothi
programme.desc: Sahil wants to marry Sneha, but his older brother Shrawan encourages him to cheat, a supposed secret to a happy marriage.

programme.title: Sachai Ki Taqat
programme.desc: Impregnated Kunti dumps her lover, marries a barrister, and abandons her illegitimate child, Munmun. Years later, Munmun discovers the truth about her mother and digs into the past.

programme.title: Accident On Hill Road
programme.desc: Drunk Sonam hits a man, his body hitting her windshield. Fearful, she conceals the crime, forever changing her life.

programme.title: Ekka Raja Rani
programme.desc: Kathak dancer Barkha saves don Vishal, suffering minor injuries. He brings her home, where she meets his arrogant brother Sagar. They fall in love, but Vishal also likes Barkha. How will he react?

programme.title: Chhote Sarkar
programme.desc: A burly Inspector, trained to eliminate criminals, seeks to wipe out crime. He's assigned to protect a nine-year-old orphan, heir to millions.

programme.title: Karz Chukana Hai
programme.desc: Rohan and Ayesha's relationship sours due to dating rumors. They part ways, only to realize their mistake.

programme.title: Jeet
programme.desc: Corporate worker Parag's life turns upside down when he's framed for drug peddling and imprisoned. He battles for acquittal and his old life.

programme.title: Jigariyaa
programme.desc: Good-for-nothing poet Shaamu falls for well-educated do-gooder Raadha. Just as they grow fond, cruel circumstances tear them apart.

programme.title: Dance Dance
programme.desc: Gaurav cares for his widowed father Janardhan. When Gaurav falls in love, he learns of his father's childhood love and insists Janardhan marries first.

programme.title: Roti
programme.desc: Kaajal moves after her husband's death. Rich Raja falls for her. As she moves on, she realizes her husband is alive.

programme.title: Masoom
programme.desc: Asha can't conceive and loses eyesight after trauma. Mother-in-law expels her, arranging Ajay's remarriage, changing everyone's lives.

programme.title: Rajaji
programme.desc: A gold-digger marries a millionaire's daughter, abandons her, then woos her again when she wins a lottery, realizing she's the gardener's daughter.

programme.title: Lorie
programme.desc: Hot-tempered Sameer moves to Goa, falls for Rani. New roommate Sunny arrives, complicating things as Rani starts liking both.

programme.title: Sanam Bewafa
programme.desc: Kedarnath feels guilty when his job replacement kills himself. He decides to support the man's family, even if it means committing crimes.

programme.title: Krodhi
programme.desc: Abandoned as a young child, lonely Vicky finds affection in a teacher and Aarti. When Aarti's uncle sells her, she kills herself to escape assault. Enraged, Vicky becomes an underworld don, seeking revenge on her molesters.

programme.title: Doli Saja Ke Rakhna
programme.desc: A comatose grandmother wakes, forcing her divorcing parents to revive their marriage and recreate the late 1980s to avoid shocking her with the present world.

programme.title: Nayee Padosan
programme.desc: Three men woo their neighbor, but her father insists she marry someone from his community.

programme.title: Joshila
programme.desc: A poetess loves a convict-poet. After his release, he's separated from her and trapped in deceit.

programme.title: Satta
programme.desc: Delhi politician Anuradha marries Mumbai's Vivek, an aspiring politician. He's arrested for murder, forcing her to take his place in elections.

programme.title: Black Mail
programme.desc: Young girls compete in a beauty contest, sharing a love-hate bond. One top contender is mysteriously murdered, prompting a police investigation.

programme.title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega
programme.desc: Jahnvi's friend Pooja attempts suicide & is saved by singer Raj. Pooja falls for Raj upon recovery, but he loves Jahnvi.

programme.title: Swarag Se Sunder
programme.desc: High-profile vigilante Arjun, working for police, seeks revenge on three crime bosses who destroyed his family by beheading his father and kidnapping his sister.

programme.title: Main Tulsi Tere Aangan Ki
programme.desc: A woman sold for marriage pines for a man who makes empty promises. Another causes a young bride's suicide. "Bazaar" highlights women's plight from misogyny.

programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Abandoned as a young child, lonely Vicky finds affection in a teacher and Aarti. When Aarti's uncle sells her, she kills herself to escape assault. Enraged, Vicky becomes an underworld don, seeking revenge on her molesters.

programme.title: Jab Pyaar Kisise Hota Hai
programme.desc: An obedient middle-class boy is torn between rock music and his mother's dream of studying abroad. A truth about his dead father jeopardizes his life.

programme.title: Rajjo
programme.desc: Rajjo, a nautch girl, and Chandu fall in love amidst Mumbai's dying Kothas, traditional art centers of singing and dancing.

programme.title: Bumm Bumm Bole
programme.desc: Young Pinu misplaces sister Rimzim's shoes. Fearing parents, he makes her share his pair until their father can afford new ones.

programme.title: Rickshawala
programme.desc: Siblings Radha and Ramu rise from poverty to become popular performers. Tragedy strikes. Ramu vows revenge on the man who exploited his mother, murdered his father, and tortured his sister.

Our corporate hero is trying to move up in his newly acquired job and discovers a secret room in his office building; his alienation deepens when he discovers a room he's told doesn't exist. Discover human behavior to find humor in the absurdity of everyday life.

programme.title: Death Of Me
programme.desc: A vacationing couple on an island off the coast of Thailand with no memory of the previous night must discover the mystery behind a strange video that shows one of them killing the other. In a web of mystery, black magic, and murder they must attempt to reconstruct the night's events & discover is she to blame for not being sacrificed or was it Mother Nature?

programme.title: Poseidon Rex
programme.desc: While searching for lost treasure, deep sea divers unleash a monster that causes havoc and destruction not only in sea but also on land.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Bad Samaritan is a terrifying thriller of two young car valets who use their business as a front to burglarize houses of customers while they eat. Their lives are turned upside down when they rob the home of a demented serial killer after making a shocking discovery of a woman being held captive. They must choose to run and hide, or face the killer whose dark secrets they have just exposed.

programme.title: Cold Skin
programme.desc: In 1914, a young man arrives at a remote island near the Antarctic Circle to take the post of weather observer only to find himself trapped in a watchtower besieged by deadly creatures which live in hiding on the island.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: Every 23rd spring for 23days, it gets to eat…Stranded on a lonely road, a school bus full of high school players must defend themselves from the Creeper, the winged, flesh-eating terror - ancient beast that resurfaces on the earth every 23 years to feed.

programme.title: Jurassic Hunt
programme.desc: In this pulse-pounding Creature thriller, Female adventurer Parker joins a crew of male trophy hunters in a remote wilderness park. Their goal: slaughter genetically recreated dinosaurs & must work together to evade the giant human-hungry creatures and mercenaries hired to finish them off. This battle's about to become primitive.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: We control the fear, you understand? Without the fear, we are all good as dead.’ The notorious gangster Al Capone observed that “Prohibition has made nothing but trouble,” and “I am like any other man. All I do is supply a demand.” Acclaimed director delivers a thrillingly vivid slice of American outlaw history in his epic gangster tale, LAWLESS. LAWLESS is the true story of the infamous Bondurant Brothers: three bootlegging siblings who made a run for the American Dream in Prohibition-era Virginia. The film gathers an ensemble of gifted, dynamic new-generation stars – Tom Hardy, Shia LaBeouf, Jessica Chastain, Jason Clarke, Mia Wasikowska, Dane DeHaan – alongside two of the finest actors of their generations, Guy Pearce and Gary Oldman. A riveting, intense story of Crime and Corruption, Loyalty and Love, Brutality and Tenderness, LAWLESS is a rich addition to the American Gangster Canon.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Riders Of Justice
programme.desc: Markus goes home to his teenage daughter, Mathilde, when his wife dies in a train crash. All appears to be a tragic accident until a mathematics geek, who was also a fellow passenger on the train, and his two colleagues show up.

programme.title: Sky Sharks
programme.desc: Deep in the ice of the antarctic, a team of geologists uncover an old Nazi warship still intact where dark experiments had occurred. In order to conquer the world, the Nazis created rocket-powered sharks whose pilots are genetically mutated, super soldiers with supernatural powers who were able to fly & destroy

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: The Good Boss
programme.desc: What makes a Good Boss? Is your boss good? Manipulative? Shamelessly meddles in his employees private lives? Crosses every line imaginable. The Good Boss is a biting character study with academy award winner Javier Bardem. To win the competition, the manipulative "good boss" unknowingly starts an explosive chain reaction with wild consequences.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: This timeless tale was originally written in 1757. Could Beauty ever love the ghastly lord, the Beast? The year is 1810. After losing his fortune at sea, a bankrupt merchant poor father-of-six, after plucking a scented rose from the repulsive master's garden must do the impossible, permit his daughter Beauty, to take his place and pay for the parent’s sins. Only true love can break the spell.

programme.title: Haywire
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Steven Soderbergh of Ocean’s 11, 12 & 13 comes HAYWIRE. A Female Assassin covert operative is hired to various global missions to perform jobs which governments can't authorize. When the operation goes awry, she needs to use all of her skills & tricks to escape an international manhunt and eliminate the last remaining link of the conspiracy against her.

programme.title: Jurassic Attack
programme.desc: A group of soldiers attempting to rescue a hostage from a terrorist crash land into unfamiliar jungles which are inhabited by a group of long hidden dinosaurs. Now they must find a way out of this isolated valley before becoming prey for prehistoric predators.

programme.title: King Lear
programme.desc: King Lear poses the question: What does it mean to be human? Its subtitle could be Being Human. Cruelty, barbarity, savagery, kindness, tenderness, love, in a world that gives not very much back. Set in the fictional present, an aging King invites disaster when he abdicates to his corrupt, toadying daughters, and rejects his loving and honest one.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: While the group of friends explore a beautiful small island, all hell breaks loose for Jessie as the rogue shark sets its hunting grounds within the vicinity. A Father with a score to settle brings his war to their doorstep.

programme.title: Rememory
programme.desc: You can’t escape them. They’re everywhere. They bring tears to our eyes. They make us laugh. They bring us pain. Gordon a visionary inventor of the Rememory machine that allows him to see memories. He dies in his office. Is it murder? Sam investigates by using the machine "borrowed" from Gordon's wife. He looks at memories of others involved. REMEMORY is a noir mystery Thriller.

programme.title: Room 203
programme.desc: Many residents of ROOM 203 have disappeared since the murder suicide of a married couple exactly fifty years ago. Lifelong friends Kim and Izzy and roommates are terrified by the vengeful spirits dwelling in their apartment. To save Izzy's life, Kim may need to sacrifice her own. Based on the Internationally Bestselling novel by Kamon Nanami.

programme.desc: Porus spares Alexander, honoring truth and hospitality, and vows to defend his motherland openly. Puru becomes King Purushottam, unites his people, and rejects alliances with the invader. While Alexander plots revenge, Porus strengthens alliances, preparing for the inevitable clash at the River Jhelum.

programme.title: Porus
programme.desc: Porus unites the Pauravs and Dasyus by proposing to Laachi, but Alexander attacks, burning granaries and taunting him with gifts. Porus vows retaliation, strengthens his kingdom, and foils conspiracies while protecting Barsine. As Alexander plots Porus’ death, war becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Porus
programme.desc: Porus rescues Barsine from Alexander’s attack and, with Chanakya’s help, survives multiple assassination plots, including a poisoned scorpion at his wedding. programme.title: Porus

programme.title: Radha Krishna Unseen Story
programme.desc: Radha’s uncontrolled anguish and harsh words toward Krishna lead to a divine curse that banishes her from Golok. She is destined to be born in the mortal world, forgetting Krishna, Golok, and even herself for a hundred years. Krishna accepts this separation as part of a greater cosmic design, choosing to bear the pain of remembrance alone. He believes their separation will transform love into a path of spiritual awakening for humanity. In the mortal world of Barsana and Gokul, destiny slowly brings them closer again. Through longing, play, and unspoken bonds, their forgotten love begins to reawaken.

programme.title: Temporary Autonomy Zone
programme.desc: For their fourth full movie Temporary Autonomy Zone the Gpsy Feelin’ boys focus on the riders’ life in a society that destroys him more than it helps him.

programme.title: The Long Hope
programme.desc: A top climber attempts a historic one-day ascent of a legendary sea cliff, while the story revisits the original first ascent 40 years earlier, contrasting extreme modern climbing with the legacy of a pioneering climber returning one last time.

programme.title: Tomorrow Will Be Better
programme.desc: Czech freestyle motocross star Libor Podmol is proof that the wildest dreams come true. In January, 2010 he flies to the US, buys a Suzuki 250 two-stroke, becomes 6 times world champ and signs a sponsorship deal with Rockstar Energy.

programme.title: California Republic
programme.desc: No other place offers such endless freedom while fueling surfing's evolution. California's blue skies, green waters, and landscapes inspire millions worldwide and shape global culture.

programme.title: Peace And Left Ii
programme.desc: A Basque freesurfer documents a five-month journey through Indonesia, traveling with family, friends, and alone, capturing his surf adventure on camera.

programme.title: All Or Nothing
programme.desc: A self-supported project celebrating two-wheel sports, filmed across Europe, featuring young talents and world-class riders in MTB, trials, BMX, and motorsports.

programme.title: Because
programme.desc: A high-end freeski documentary following 22 professional athletes across record snowfall winters, facing deep powder, massive cliffs, and extreme expeditions, while sharing their ambition, discipline, and drive to reach the next level of their careers.

programme.title: Begging For Change
programme.desc: This movie is about the lives of strange and exhilarating men, begging for change, and living a life that is fast, cheap, and affordable. All the things that make up a great ski movie

programme.title: Chaiyo Premiere Tour
programme.desc: A skate documentary following a 10-day tour across Thailand, featuring demos and premieres in several cities, capturing the energy of local skate scenes and the passion of skaters coming together to celebrate.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: En Route America
programme.desc: A road trip across the West Coast, following skiers as they explore iconic mountains and chase winter conditions across the United States.

programme.title: En Route Departure
programme.desc: Follow Pep Fujas, Blake Nyman, Anthony Boronowski, Dylan Hood, Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and more as they chase storms from a Top Secret Military Mountain Warfare Facility, to the Italian Alps.

programme.title: En Route Departure
programme.desc: Follow Pep Fujas, Blake Nyman, Anthony Boronowski, Dylan Hood, Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and more as they chase storms from a Top Secret Military Mountain Warfare Facility, to the Italian Alps.

programme.title: Falling Angels
programme.desc: Three female BASE jumpers trek deep into the Venezuelan jungle to attempt a historic jump from the world’s highest waterfall, facing extreme terrain, technical challenges, and one of the most dangerous exits in the sport.

programme.title: Gunnie Season
programme.desc: An extreme skiing film featuring some of the world’s top professional skiers pushing their limits on snow and steep terrain.

programme.title: Peace And Left
programme.desc: A surf series following Hugues Oyarzabal, capturing spectacular first-person barrel footage at iconic spots around the globe, offering a rare inside view of high-performance surfing.

programme.title: Pour Vous Servir

programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h.
